definitions.explanation: assistance or support given to those in danger or distress

⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{救援|きゅうえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。

notes:
{救援|きゅうえん} means to rescue or provide relief, typically in emergency situations.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {救|きゅう}: To save, rescue
- {援|えん}: To assist, support

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救援|きゅうえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to rescue, to provide relief)
- {救援|きゅうえん}⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (rescue team)
- {救援|きゅうえん}⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧ (relief supplies)
- {救援|きゅうえん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (relief activities)
- {救援|きゅうえん}⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧ (request for rescue)
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{救援|きゅうえん} (international relief)

USAGE:
- Used in disaster, military, and emergency contexts
- Often appears in news about earthquakes, floods, conflicts

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧ (rescue - more immediate, physical saving)
- ⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧ (support, aid - broader meaning)
- ⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧ (assistance, aid)

REGISTER: Neutral to formal. Common in news and official contexts.
